source.constructor: exact F124-Y public generator wrapper bytecode with only cohort binding replaced

Wingless.hypothesis: Sparse adjacency traversal, encode bits only for edges reached by 3-per-node model, no full graph compressed-encoding buffers and no persistent per-edge prospective-lookahead cache. Preserve original W selected checksum and exact float-operation order/readout, bitwise-compare original indexed & original V-bytecode same-checksum outputs for every public case. Sparse adjacency index only and original states are extra memory.

bench.resource_match: both median wall-clock time <= fixed and median Python allocations <= fixed
bench.preregistered_failure: If equal logits fail, quarantine. If resource match fails, retain negative; accuracy alone is not acceptance.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Augment each retained/active cell with source-blind public-key continuity count, which is accumulated when carried destination bits exactly match the next public source bits. Preserve original F124-Q hard active 7 + retained 9 priorities, cell scores, original weights and delta, and exact original logits prior to readout. Only new final readout penalty separates key-inconsistent terminal chains.
Yggdrasil.fit_selection: On new FIT pairs only, choose penalty maximizing paired correct positives+negatives; ties smallest penalty. Fresh DEV generated after penalty fixed.
Yggdrasil.feature: max(source-key-consistent hop count/depth) across original T terminal cells. First source from start is unconditioned. Source bit equality is a PUBLIC relation, not hidden oracle path or labels.
Yggdrasil.extra_state: One bounded per-cell counter or equivalent; include this metadata in resource comparison. No other new states.
